Natural Specimen & Lapidary Carving Collection
Mixed Mineral, Fossil, and Shell Lot
Quartz Crystal, Fossiliferous Stone, Pearlized Shell, 7 Pieces
This seven-piece natural history and lapidary lot features an attractive mix of geologic formations, polished marine life, and carved fossil stone. The collection includes five natural quartz crystal geode halves showcasing sparkling druse interiors, an iridescent pearlized Trochus top shell, and a polished Moroccan-style fossil stone stingray carving embedded with prehistoric marine inclusions.
5 natural quartz geode halves with exposed white crystalline drusy interiors and rough tan matrix
1 polished mother-of-pearl Trochus sea shell with shimmering nacre and spiral whorl
1 polished carved fossil limestone stingray figure showing fossilized cephalopod inclusions, fitted with a small stone riser block on the underside
Suitable for cabinet display, specimen study, or decorative lapidary arrangements
Condition:
All specimens are in very good display condition. Quartz geode halves retain clean crystal faces with natural rough exterior edges. Pearlized shell shows clean spiral form with smooth polished finish and minimal handling wear. Carved fossil stone stingray is intact with a high-gloss polished top surface, intact tail tip, and securely affixed stone support block underneath.
